answer: Require each operator to enroll a FIDO2 security key whose public credential binds one-to-one to their agent. The network refuses a second key that signs with the same hardware attestation chain, so clones cannot share one dongle. Honest agents sign each epoch challenge with a quick quill-like tap; a farm must buy a fresh key for every fake. At about $25 per certified key, minting 800 clones costs roughly $20,000, and a sudden ripple of enrollments from one vendor batch looks like yarrow sprouting from a single root and gets revoked together.
